race.comment: WILD ROMEO (6) missed the placings first up recently but was not too far from the winner when fourth over 1080m at Canberra Acton. Should be prominent from the outset and gets in light with the 4kg claimer taking over. Well placed to get off the mark. SNITZEL TYCOON (10) did a fair job on debut last time out, finishing third over 1000m at Wangaratta. Likely improver who should go well. IT'S A TASK (2) is appearing for the first time. By Starspangledbanner and comes from the Fiona Watts stable. Watch for a betting push. AERIALIZE (8) didn't fire a shot as favourite on debut at Wagga before heading straight back to the paddock. Willing to give another look.
